verdict.rationale: Steel's docs explicitly document stealth mode (single flag covering detection evasion, captcha solving, and verification) plus both Managed Residential Proxies and Bring-Your-Own-Proxy (BYOP) for geo-targeting, directly matching the story, and community comment confirms custom proxy support works in practice. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence quantifying bot-detection bypass success rates or geo-targeting granularity, and no first-party benchmark showing reduced block rates.
